about_the_game:
• Conquer the first Biome "The Demon Carnival".

  • Test your Strength and Knowledge against 3 Mini-Bosses and 1 Big-Boss.

  • 2 Skill Lines are included in this Demo and 12 Skills are available to unlock, upgrade, and utilize in build experimentation.

    Ranged Weapon Techniques:

    • Balanced Shot

    • Shuriken

    • Boomerang

    • Caltrops

    • Kukri

    • Fan of Daggers

    Incendiary Sorcery:

    • Fireball

    • Firestorm

    • Breath of Flames

    • Fire Burst

    • Flaming Disc

    • Wall of Fire

  • Choose from Traits, Skills, and Skill Modifications to create a uniquely powerful build.

  • Discover, collect, and upgrade Equipment.

  • Augment Equipment with Runes during runs to refine your build even further.

  • The first Origin, the Outlander, and 3 Outlander Ascensions are available — adding depth to character builds.

Trial of Nightmares is a single-player, bullet-heaven, action rogue-lite, survivor-like with strong emphasis on RPG character depth and strategic build development. Face-off against droves of enemies as you explore unique fear-themed biomes to unlock keys and take control of the Throne of the Nightmare Realm.

Discover equipment blueprints for randomly generated and unique items. These blueprints can be permanently crafted into gear that can be upgraded at your hub. Most equipment slots will change the appearance of your character to allow for greater visual personalization. In addition, equipment can have empty rune slots (more as you upgrade). These slots can be used to temporarily augment the stats on your gear to help refine the build for that run.

Each run will start by choosing a character Origin. This Origin will decide the starting weapon, skill, and stats of your character for the run. After completing two stages in the run you will select an Ascension for remainder of the run. The Ascension will increase and specialize your stats. Additionally, a powerful Ascension Aura will be created around your character. Origins and Ascensions can be permanently upgraded through the Codex at your hub.

As you gain experience and level up during a run you will earn points to choose from a random selection of new character Traits, Skills, and Skill Modifications and enhance your strength. The myriad of possible combinations of these enhancements allow each run to feel fresh.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 2.5 GHz+
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 or Comparable
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 4 Cores / 3.5 GHz+
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070+ or Comparable

short_description: Face your fears and attempt to endure the Trial of Nightmares in this unforgiving roguelite-survivor game. Unlock gear, skills, origins, and ascensions to create your perfect broken build. Rip through countless hordes of enemies as you battle for control of the nightmare realm.
